name: Disable ISATAP
description: Disables ISATAP, a legacy IPv6 transition technology that allows IPv6 traffic to be carried over IPv4 networks. This simplifies the Windows TCP/IP stack by removing unnecessary tunneling behavior on modern home and gaming systems.

description_i18n.en: Disables ISATAP, a legacy IPv6 transition technology that allows IPv6 traffic to be carried over IPv4 networks. This simplifies the Windows TCP/IP stack by removing unnecessary tunneling behavior on modern home and gaming systems.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert ISATAP, eine ältere IPv6-Übergangstechnologie für den Transport von IPv6-Datenverkehr über IPv4-Netzwerke. Dies vereinfacht den Windows-TCP/IP-Stack und entfernt unnötiges Tunneling auf modernen Heim- und Gaming-Systemen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive ISATAP, une ancienne technologie de transition IPv6 permettant le transport du trafic IPv6 sur des réseaux IPv4. Cela simplifie la pile TCP/IP de Windows en éliminant les comportements de tunnelage inutiles.

warnings.title: Network Behavior Change
warnings.message: Disabling this legacy feature does not increase internet speed, FPS, or raw bandwidth. It only removes a specific IPv6-over-IPv4 tunneling mechanism that most modern systems do not require

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Uses netsh interface isatap commands to detect and configure the ISATAP state, setting it to disabled or restoring default behavior
